title: Medical Test (Bayes)
problem:
A disease affects 1% of a population. A test for the disease is 95% accurate when the person has the disease (true positive rate), and gives a false positive 8% of the time when the person does NOT have the disease.

Build a tree diagram from scratch that models a randomly selected person being tested. Use the first level of branches for whether the person has the disease, and the second level for the test result.

questions.prompt: Find P(has disease AND tests positive).
Find P(does NOT have disease AND tests positive).
Given a positive test, find P(has disease) — i.e., P(D | +).
